{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Lu Ban|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Lu Ban''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores [[Mending]]. It is crafted from a [[Divine Favor]], six diamonds and a {{MCW|Block of Diamond|block of diamond}}, making it one of the two most expensive blessings.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/mending.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Lu Ban" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Lu Ban is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Mending applies to any item with durability. The only other sources are loot and the Prayer of Belial [[Ofuda]]. The book has epic rarity.

== Trivia ==
* Lu Ban is a Chinese carpenter and engineer, venerated as the patron of builders and craftsmen, fitting an enchantment that keeps tools repaired.
